highlight.js 11.11.1 (common-languages build, plus the `powershell` language module — the dominant hinted language in the reference export and absent from the common build) with the GitHub light theme (`github.min.css`) and, since v1.3.0's dark mode, the GitHub dark theme (`github-dark.min.css`, same 11.11.1 release; the templates select between them by theme and media query — print always loads the light theme), all vendored from https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release — see LICENSE (BSD-3-Clause) alongside.
